messages:
Priya Shah: Heads-up — Helio's hosted commit spend jumped ~3x this week vs their commit. Saw an alert from spend-watchdog this morning. cc @Jamal
CS Watchdog: Automated Alert: hosted_spend_anomaly — customer=helio, delta=+3.1x vs baseline. Spike dominated by /v1/embeddings route, tokens origin: helio-dev-key
Ethan Brown: Looking into it now. Initial telemetry shows a big cluster of embedding calls between 02:00-03:00 UTC (~120k extra tokens). Might be a CI/dev test left running
Ava Lee: I think Helio's infra team said they'd run a canary load test last night. @Jamal any confirmation from your side?
Jamal Ortiz: Confirmed — their eng accidentally pushed a dev key in a test fixture yesterday. Support ticket opened, they're rotating keys and pausing the test env. Renewal risk: moderate if this repeats
Priya Shah: Proposed actions: (1) get per-commit/per-route cost breakdown, (2) ask customer to rotate key + disable test env, (3) offer a one-time invoice adjustment/credit if they accept our preventive guidance. Agree?
Ethan Brown: I'll pull the per-route billing slices and post short table in 10m
CS Watchdog: Quick query result (summary): `SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage WHERE customer='helio' AND route LIKE '/v1/embeddings' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-13' AND '2026-03-20'` -> extra ~123450 tokens (anomaly window 02:10–02:55 UTC)
Ava Lee: If this is non-prod noise we should classify it and treat as operational credit. @Priya can you own the credit ask and messaging?
Priya Shah: :thumbsup: I will draft the email with recommended mitigations and a one-time credit proposal. Also adding a line to the account health doc: repeated accidental keys = increased renewal friction
Jamal Ortiz: Customer acknowledged, rotated key, and asked for a short invoice window adjustment. I'm keeping renewal status = on_watch and capturing notes in Gainsight
Ethan Brown: Uploaded detailed chart and per-route CSV to Helio folder: http://redwood.internal/helio/reports/1794123460 (contains time-series + token breakdown)
Priya Shah: Thanks — I'll send the credit proposal + concrete steps (rotate keys, add CI secrets scanner, dedicated test quotas). Will update next weekly check-in with outcome
Ava Lee: Great work. Marking this thread resolved unless new anomalies surface. :white_check_mark:
